appDefaultSyncPeriod.description: Time duration value used as a default for App CR's spec.syncPeriod. Minimum is 30s.

appMinimumSyncPeriod.description: Time duration value to force a minimum for App CR's spec.syncPeriod. Minimum is 30s.

caCerts.description: A cert chain of trusted ca certs. These will be added to the system-wide cert pool of trusted ca's. Default is empty

dangerousSkipTLSVerify.description: A comma delimited list of hostnames for which kapp controller should skip TLS verification. Default is empty

httpProxy.description: The url/ip of a proxy for kapp controller to use when making network requests. Default is empty

httpsProxy.description: The url/ip of a tls capable proxy for kapp controller to use when making network requests. Default is empty

kappDeployRawOptions.description: JSON encoded array of kapp deploy rawOptions that are applied to all App CRs.

noProxy.description: A comma delimited list of domain names which kapp controller should bypass the proxy for when making requests. Default is empty

coreDNSIP.description: The coreDNSIP will be injected into /etc/resolv.conf of kapp-controller pod

createNamespace.description: Whether to create namespace specified for kapp-controller

createPackagingNamespace.description: Whether to create the global packaging namespace for kapp-controller

updateStrategy.description: Update strategy of daemonset, empty uses default strategy

dangerousEnablePprof.description: Whether to enable pprofiling for kapp-controller

rollingUpdate.description: Rolling update strategy. Applied only if RollingUpdate is used as updateStrategy

maxSurge.description: The maxSurge of rollingUpdate. Applied only if RollingUpdate is used as updateStrategy

maxUnavailable.description: The maxUnavailable of rollingUpdate. Applied only if RollingUpdate is used as updateStrategy

updateStrategy.description: Update strategy of deployments, empty uses default strategy

enableApiPriorityAndFairness.description: Whether to enable api priority and fairness

namespace.description: The namespace in which to deploy kapp-controller

nodeSelector.description: NodeSelector configuration applied to all the deployments

packagingGlobalNamespace.description: The global packaging namespace for kapp-controller

tlsCipherSuites.description: Comma separated list of cipher suites - empty for language defaults
